svg.title: How the findings of a tool reach their lines
svg.desc: A push to a pull request, also one from a fork, runs scripts/check.sh in the CI. Ruff, Psalm and Biome write their findings as annotations on their own, and the TypeScript compiler through the problem matcher of actions/setup-node. ShellCheck, mypy, PHP CS Fixer and the tests of Node write lines that blueprint.py annotate reads and passes on to the log as they are, and pytest and PHPUnit write a report of JUnit that it reads after a test failed. blueprint.py annotate writes one annotation for each finding, at a file of the repository only and with every text escaped. GitHub keeps the annotations of the check run, the files of the pull request show each finding at its line, and the PR coach lists them in its one comment.
